settings.heading: I've already tried probiotics. How is this different?
settings.content: Probiotics add more bacteria to your gut. These drops do a different job. Garlic helps break down the protective layer bacteria build around themselves, and oregano, wormwood and black walnut work on what was hiding underneath.* If the problem is bacteria that are already there and well protected, adding more bacteria doesn't reach them.

settings.heading: A treatment helped for a while, then it all came back. Why would this be different?
settings.content:
That's the most common story we hear. Bacteria can shelter under a slimy protective layer called biofilm, ride out a round of treatment, then grow back once it ends. Our formula leads with garlic, which lab studies show can help break down that layer, so the other botanicals can reach what's underneath.*

These drops are a dietary supplement, not a replacement for medical care. Talk to your doctor about what's right for you.

settings.heading: My main issue is bloating after meals. Can this help?
settings.content: That's exactly who we made it for. When unwanted bacteria build up in your gut, they ferment your food, and that gas is the bloat you feel building through the day. By helping clear that buildup, these drops support calmer digestion with less bloating and gas.*

settings.heading: How long should I take it?
settings.content: Give it at least 90 days of daily use. The shield and what's behind it don't build up overnight, and they don't clear overnight either. If you plan to keep going after that, check in with your healthcare provider.

settings.heading: Why drops instead of capsules?
settings.content: A dropper lets you start small and build up. Herbs like garlic, oregano and wormwood can feel strong at first, so starting with a few drops and working up to a full dropper is easier on a sensitive stomach than a full-strength capsule on day one. Drops also mix easily into water or juice.

settings.heading: What does it taste like?
settings.content: Earthy and bitter. Wormwood is one of the most bitter herbs there is, so most people mix their dropper into a small glass of water or juice.

settings.heading: Is there a guarantee?
settings.content: Yes, a full 90-day money-back guarantee. Clearing what's behind the shield takes time, so you get the whole 90 days to feel the difference. If it doesn't work for you, we'll refund you in full.

settings.heading: The Reason Your Bloating Keeps Coming Back
settings.heading_highlight: Is Not What You Were Told
settings.body:
When unwanted bacteria build up in your gut, they don't sit out in the open. Over time they wrap themselves in a slimy protective layer called biofilm. Think of it as a shield.

Diets, probiotics, even a round of treatment can knock down the bacteria out in the open. The ones under the shield ride it out, then grow back once it's over. And the bloating comes back with them.

settings.heading: Break the shield. Clear what's behind it.
settings.body: First, garlic helps break down the protective layer bacteria hide behind. Then oregano, wormwood and black walnut go to work on what was hiding underneath. Pau d'arco, pumpkin seed and soursop round out the blend with herbs traditionally used for gut balance.* Seven botanicals. One daily dropper.

settings.question: Who should not take these drops?
settings.answer: Talk to your doctor first if you are pregnant, nursing or trying to conceive, under 18, taking blood thinners or any prescription medication, or have a seizure disorder, a liver, kidney or gallbladder condition, or an allergy to plants in the daisy (ragweed) family, which includes wormwood.

settings.question: How do I take it?
settings.answer: Shake well. Start with a few drops in a small glass of water or juice once a day, then work up to one full dropper daily, or follow the directions on your label.

settings.question: Will I feel anything when I start?
settings.answer: As the herbs get to work, some people notice temporary changes in gas or digestion during the first days. Starting with a few drops and building up slowly helps. If anything feels wrong, stop and speak to your doctor.

settings.question: When should I see a doctor instead?
settings.answer: Bloating that comes with weight loss, blood in your stool, vomiting, fever or severe pain needs a doctor, not a supplement. These drops are for everyday digestive support.*

settings.question: What's your guarantee?
settings.answer: You have a full 90 days to try it. If you don't feel lighter and less bloated, email our team for a 100% refund.
